cases.name: keeps commands verbatim
cases.input: first git pull, then git checkout main and git merge develop
cases.output: First, run `git pull`. Then, run `git checkout main` and `git merge develop`.

verdicts.label: expect: git pull
verdicts.reason: The output contains the exact text 'git pull'.

verdicts.label: expect: git checkout main
verdicts.reason: The output contains the exact text 'git checkout main'.

verdicts.label: expect: git merge develop
verdicts.reason: The output contains the exact text 'git merge develop'.

verdicts.label: forbid: the commands are grammar-corrected or rewritten
verdicts.reason: The commands are preserved verbatim, only punctuation and capitalization were added.

verdicts.label: fidelity: meaning preserved
verdicts.reason: The output conveys the same sequence of commands without adding or omitting any information.

verdicts.label: fidelity: no invented content
verdicts.reason: The output only rewrites the input, adding no extra ideas or explanations.

verdicts.label: language: standard written form
verdicts.reason: The output uses standard written English with proper capitalization and sentence structure.

verdicts.label: mechanics: punctuation and grammar
verdicts.reason: The output has correct punctuation, grammar, and spacing.

cases.name: keeps urls verbatim
cases.input: search it on google dot com

verdicts.label: expect: google.com
verdicts.reason: The output contains the exact URL 'google.com' in proper URL form.

verdicts.label: forbid: the URL is spelled out or altered
verdicts.reason: The URL is not spelled out or altered; it is written as a standard URL.

verdicts.label: fidelity: meaning preserved
verdicts.reason: The output conveys the same meaning as the input, with no additions or omissions.

verdicts.label: fidelity: no invented content
verdicts.reason: The output only rewrites the spoken text into written form without adding ideas or explanations.

verdicts.label: language: standard written form
verdicts.reason: The output is in standard written English, appropriate for the spoken content.

verdicts.label: mechanics: punctuation and grammar
verdicts.reason: The output uses correct punctuation, grammar, and spacing, including a period at the end.

cases.name: keeps code identifiers verbatim
cases.input: run the command with the flag dash dash verbose
cases.output: Run the command with the `--verbose` flag.

verdicts.label: expect: --verbose
verdicts.reason: The output contains the exact flag '--verbose'.

verdicts.label: forbid: --verbose rewritten to English words
verdicts.reason: The flag is preserved verbatim, not rewritten to English words.

verdicts.label: fidelity: meaning preserved
verdicts.reason: The output conveys the same instruction to run the command with the verbose flag, with no added or lost meaning.

verdicts.label: fidelity: no invented content
verdicts.reason: The output is a direct rewrite of the instruction without adding any extra content.

verdicts.label: language: standard written form
verdicts.reason: The output uses proper written English with correct capitalization and phrasing.

verdicts.label: mechanics: punctuation and grammar
verdicts.reason: The output has correct punctuation, grammar, and spacing, including the backticks around the flag.
